notes.title: Plomarc'h Pella archaeological site added! 2.0.4 update
notes.content:
Additions:
	- Discover Plomarc'h Pella archaeological site as it is now and travel to Roman times to see the reconstructed building.
	- Anna Rosa and Plomarc'h Pella : Added French and English voiceovers with 3D audio rendering.
	- Support for Windows Mixed Reality headsets.
	- Language choice in the menu.

Modifications:
	- Optimization: +10% of images per second.

Special thank you to:
- Balian The Mighty for the texts translation
- Calem Bendell for his voiceover
